cards.card_text: They throw in their lot with adulterers too.
cards.verse_text: When you see a thief, you befriend him, and throw in your lot with adulterers.
cards.snippet: …see a thief, you befriend him, and throw in your lot with adulterers.

cards.card_text: Now God calls a group forward, and He doesn't hold back: "But come here, you sons of a sorceress, you offspring of adulterers and prostitutes!" Then He asks who they think they're mocking, sneering at and sticking their tongues out at.
cards.verse_text: “But come here, you sons of a sorceress, you offspring of adulterers and prostitutes!
cards.snippet: “But come here, you sons of a sorceress, you offspring of adulterers and prostitutes!

cards.card_text: The prophet says the land is full of adulterers.
cards.verse_text: For the land is full of adulterers—because of the curse, the land mourns and the pastures of the wilderness have dried up—their course is evil and their power is misused.
cards.snippet: For the land is full of adulterers—because of the curse, the land mourns and the pastures of the wilderness…

cards.card_text: Then God pulls out a picture: they are all adulterers, like an oven heated by a baker.
cards.verse_text: They are all adulterers, like an oven heated by a baker who needs not stoke the fire from the kneading to the rising of the dough.

cards.card_text: Then the LORD of Hosts says, "Then I will draw near to you for judgment." He will be a witness against sorcerers, adulterers, perjurers and those who oppress the widowed and fatherless.
cards.verse_text: And I will be a swift witness against sorcerers and adulterers and perjurers, against oppressors of the widowed and fatherless, and against those who defraud laborers of their wages and deny justice to the foreigner but do not fear Me,” says the LORD of Hosts.

cards.card_text: Then he lists them: swindlers, evildoers, adulterers, "or even like this tax collector." Friend, he came to talk to God, and he's out here NAMING NAMES.
cards.verse_text: The Pharisee stood by himself and prayed, ‘God, I thank You that I am not like other men—swindlers, evildoers, adulterers—or even like this tax collector.
cards.snippet: …‘God, I thank You that I am not like other men—swindlers, evildoers, adulterers—or even like this tax collector.

cards.card_text: Then he lists who won't inherit the kingdom of God: the sexually immoral, idolaters, adulterers, men who submit to or perform homosexual acts, thieves, the greedy, drunkards, verbal abusers and swindlers.
cards.verse_text: Do not be deceived: Neither the sexually immoral, nor idolaters, nor adulterers, nor men who submit to or perform homosexual acts, nor thieves, nor the greedy, nor drunkards, nor verbal abusers, nor swindlers, will inherit the kingdom of God.

cards.card_text: He says God will judge the sexually immoral and adulterers.
cards.verse_text: Marriage should be honored by all and the marriage bed kept undefiled, for God will judge the sexually immoral and adulterers.
cards.snippet: …marriage bed kept undefiled, for God will judge the sexually immoral and adulterers.
